items.name: NullBuffer
items.summary: A [`BooleanBuffer`] used to encode validity (null values) for Arrow arrays

methods.name: buffer
methods.summary: Returns the underlying [`Buffer`]

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Claim memory used by this null buffer in the provided memory pool.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Returns true if all nulls in `other` also exist in self

methods.name: expand
methods.summary: Returns a new [`NullBuffer`] where each bit in the current null buffer is repeated `count` times. This is useful for masking the nulls of the child of a FixedSizeListArray based on its parent

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<T: IntoIterator<Item = bool>>(iter: T) -> Self

methods.name: from_unsliced_buffer
methods.signature: fn from_unsliced_buffer(buffer: impl Into<Buffer>, len: usize) -> Option<Self>
methods.summary: Create a [`NullBuffer`] from an *unsliced* validity bitmap (`offset = 0` **bits**) of length `len`.

methods.name: inner
methods.summary: Returns the inner [`BooleanBuffer`]

methods.name: into_inner
methods.summary: Returns the inner [`BooleanBuffer`]

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if this [`NullBuffer`] is empty

methods.name: is_null
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the value at `idx` is null

methods.name: is_valid
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the value at `idx` is not null

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the bits in this [`NullBuffer`]

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the length of this [`NullBuffer`] in bits

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new [`NullBuffer`] computing the null count

methods.name: new_null
methods.summary: Create a new [`NullBuffer`] of length `len` where all values are null

methods.name: new_unchecked
methods.signature: unsafe fn new_unchecked(buffer: BooleanBuffer, null_count: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`NullBuffer`] with the provided `buffer` and `null_count`

methods.name: new_valid
methods.summary: Create a new [`NullBuffer`] of length `len` where all values are valid

methods.name: null_count
methods.summary: Returns the null count for this [`NullBuffer`]

methods.name: offset
methods.summary: Returns the offset of this [`NullBuffer`] in bits

methods.name: shrink_to_fit
methods.summary: Free up unused memory.

methods.name: slice
methods.signature: fn slice(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Slices this [`NullBuffer`] by the provided `offset` and `length`

methods.name: try_for_each_valid_idx
methods.signature: fn try_for_each_valid_idx<E, F: FnMut(usize) -> Result<(), E>>(&self, f: F) -> Result<(), E>
methods.summary: Calls the provided closure for each index in this null mask that is set

methods.name: union
methods.signature: fn union(lhs: Option<&NullBuffer>, rhs: Option<&NullBuffer>) -> Option<NullBuffer>
methods.summary: Computes the union of the nulls in two optional [`NullBuffer`]

methods.name: union_many
methods.signature: fn union_many<'a>(nulls: impl IntoIterator<Item = Option<&'a NullBuffer>>) -> Option<NullBuffer>
methods.summary: Computes the union of the nulls in multiple optional [`NullBuffer`]s

methods.name: valid_indices
methods.summary: Returns a [`BitIndexIterator`] over the valid indices in this [`NullBuffer`]

methods.name: valid_slices
methods.summary: Returns a [`BitSliceIterator`] yielding contiguous ranges of valid indices

methods.name: validity
methods.summary: Returns the packed validity of this [`NullBuffer`] not including any offset
